features.name: x1_x2_product
features.description: Product of X1 and X2, capturing their linear interaction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear SVM to capture the multiplicative interaction between X1 and X2 without requiring a non-linear kernel.

features.name: x3_squared_deviation
features.description: Squared deviation of X3 from its center point of 0.5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms the U-shaped relationship of X3 around its center into a linear feature, enabling the SVM to fit it with a single weight.

features.name: x4_x5_sum
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two potentially additive features into a single smooth composite, reducing the dimensionality and stabilizing the SVM margin.

features.name: x1_squared
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a quadratic transformation of X1, allowing the linear model to approximate non-linear curves along this dimension.

features.name: x2_squared
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a quadratic transformation of X2, allowing the linear model to approximate non-linear curves along this dimension.

features.name: x1_x2_interaction_squared
features.description: Squared product of X1 and X2.
features.expected_model_benefit: Higher-order interaction term that gives the linear SVM flexibility to fit steeper non-linear gradients in the X1-X2 plane.

features.name: x3_abs_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of X3 from its center point of 0.5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a V-shaped continuous severity measure from the center of X3, useful for margin-based linear classifiers.

features.name: x4_x5_product
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the interaction between X4 and X5, providing an additional orthogonal feature for the linear SVM.

features.name: signal_features_mean
features.description: Mean of the first five features (X1 to X5).
features.expected_model_benefit: Averaged composite of the first five features, providing a smooth, normalized score that can act as a strong linear baseline.

features.name: noise_features_mean
features.description: Mean of the last five features (X6 to X10).
features.expected_model_benefit: Averaged composite of the last five features, which can help the model identify and potentially down-weight background noise.

features.name: signal_complexity_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of the non-linear interaction potential among the first five features, evaluating their combined magnitude and variance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, non-formulaic measure of signal complexity that can help the SVM adjust its margin in dense regions.

features.name: noise_level_estimate
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the background noise level based on the last five features, assessing their deviation from expected uniform behavior.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a continuous severity measure for noise, allowing the linear SVM to potentially regularize or adapt its confidence.
